offering_description.value: Owns and operates outpatient physical and occupational therapy clinics treating patients with musculoskeletal injuries, post-surgical needs and work-related injuries. Also manages physical therapy practices owned with partners and provides industrial injury prevention services to employers.

primary_services.value: outpatient physical therapy; occupational therapy; hand therapy; industrial injury prevention and work conditioning; physical therapy practice management

customer_segment.value: B2C: patients referred by physicians, covered by insurance, treated in clinics; B2B: employers using industrial injury prevention services, practice partners

end_markets.value: healthcare; outpatient rehabilitation; workers' compensation and occupational health

revenue_model.value: healthcare reimbursement: payments from commercial insurers, Medicare, workers' compensation and other payors for therapy visits; service fees: employer-paid injury prevention services and management fees from practice partners

value_chain_position.value: service provider: employs therapists delivering rehabilitation care to patients referred by physicians; asset operator: owns and runs a network of outpatient clinics

geography_served.value: US national: Clinics across many US states

specialization.value: related lines: outpatient physical therapy clinics, industrial injury prevention and practice management

distribution_channels.value: own locations: company-owned and partnership-owned outpatient therapy clinics; other: physician referrals and employer on-site programs

regulatory_exposure.value: high: healthcare provider licensing, Medicare and Medicaid reimbursement rules, state therapy practice laws, HIPAA
